output.summary: formatPrice gains a currency parameter and tax gains a rate parameter, and their callers in the TypeScript and Python files are updated to match. The four formatPrice callers pass 'USD' and the two tax callers pass 0.2. Several other edits look unrelated: the config currency, the legacyLabel text and formatPrice import from legacy/price.ts, the viaMethod call on Fmt, and the Calc.tax call in calc.py. Check that every formatPrice caller should pass 'USD' and that the 0.2 rate is intended in each tax caller.

groups.title: formatPrice gains a currency parameter
groups.description: The definition now takes a currency and prefixes it to the formatted amount. Read it first. Confirm that the output format change is intended for every consumer.

groups.title: Price callers pass 'USD'
groups.description: Four summary functions and aliasCaller now pass 'USD' to formatPrice. Check that none should pass another currency.

groups.title: tax gains a rate parameter
groups.description: tax now takes an optional rate, defaulting to 0.1, and multiplies by it. Existing one-argument calls keep their old behaviour. Check the default is still right.

groups.title: Tax callers pass a 0.2 rate
groups.description: order_total and refund now pass 0.2 as the rate. Check that both should use 0.2 rather than the default.

groups.title: Edits that look unrelated
groups.description: These changes do not call the changed formatPrice or tax functions. viaMethod calls a method on Fmt, and use_calc calls a method on Calc. legacyLabel uses the separate legacy formatPrice and changes its label. config.json changes the currency value. Confirm each one is intended.

edgeVerdicts.reason: The receiver f is typed Fmt, so f.formatPrice is the Fmt method, not the changed top-level formatPrice function.
Calc().tax is a method on Calc, not the changed top-level tax function in tax.py.
